panels.description: The group emerges through a storm drain into Halyard: bronze towers, glass laboratories and engineered greenery. Keep Alex, Ada, B11 and TJ small against the city; leave sky space.
Soaked and dust-streaked, Alex, Ada and B11 pass a polished checkpoint while TJ follows low. Keep the gate and white-and-amber node prominent.
A worker's hand is stopped by a House scanner; no face required. Keep the polished scanner and hand clear.
Alex's identity band opens a public registry while Ada looks up at the towers. Leave upper commercial signage space.
